product_one_liner.value: ON3 Works uses AI sourcing and technical vetting to find and shortlist engineers, developers and IT specialists for companies hiring in the United Kingdom and Spain.
product_one_liner.notes: The official description identifies the AI-native recruiting service, its technical talent focus and its customer markets. Source: https://on3works.com/about

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes the Agentic and Atelier recruiting offerings. Source: https://on3works.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: The homepage testimonial section names CGI, but no second named customer was found on the reviewed customer evidence. The requested minimum-two rule therefore produces an empty list, not a claim that ON3 has no customers. Source: https://on3works.com/

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 14 employees, which maps to 11-20. Profile-associated headcount may differ from payroll headcount. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/on3works

hq_location.notes: normalizer: partial location recorded as unknown (hq_city=null, hq_country="Spain") | hq_city: The official headquarters disclosure names Mallorca, an island, rather than a city. The founders are separately located in Sant Joan and Palma, so neither town can safely be assigned as headquarters. Source: https://on3works.com/about | hq_country: The official about page lists headquarters as Mallorca, Spain, remote-first. Source: https://on3works.com/about

founded_year.notes: The official company facts explicitly state that ON3 Works was founded in 2022. Source: https://on3works.com/about

eng_blog.notes: The readable Insights index covers recruitment fees, hiring comparisons, salaries and hiring locations. It does not establish two engineer-authored posts about building the product; the AI-pipeline explainer alone would not qualify. Source: https://on3works.com/insights

public_docs.notes: The reviewed homepage navigation and footer link to service pages, recruitment resources and FAQs, but not a product documentation site, help center or developer portal. Source: https://on3works.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Unknown: no verifiable internal careers page or job board for this company was located. The official candidates page concerns recruitment clients, and the third-party careers listing could not reliably establish ON3 Works' own vacancies. Reviewed: https://on3works.com/candidates and https://jenniejohnson.com/company/on3-works

model_provider.value: Google Gemini, OpenAI and Cohere, disclosed for its owned Hiron platform.
model_provider.notes: Hiron's processor list names Cohere for embeddings, Google Gemini for resume extraction and OpenAI as the extraction fallback. ON3 Works explicitly identifies Hiron as its owned sourcing infrastructure; this disclosure does not establish the models behind every ON3 recruiting function. Sources: https://hiron.ai/privacy and https://on3works.com/ai-recruiting

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The Hiron privacy notice, issued by ON3 WORKS LTD, names UK GDPR and describes safeguards under it. GDPR is included as one of the requested compliance labels, not as an independently audited certification. Source: https://hiron.ai/privacy | compliance_certs.0: The legal notice expressly names UK GDPR. This is a compliance reference, not evidence of independent certification. Source: https://hiron.ai/privacy

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying product or major-feature launch was found in the readable Insights index or visible company posts within the requested six-month window. The dated product-capability explainer is from February 2024; the October 2026 post is advice for juniors, not a launch. Public post coverage may be incomplete. Sources: https://on3works.com/insights and https://linkedin.com/company/on3works

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small, fully reviewed team page identifies the two founders, established in 2022, as the current leadership; no new C-level or VP appointment or departure was found for the requested window. This is an absence-based finding, not a comprehensive personnel record. Sources: https://on3works.com/about-us and https://on3works.com/about
